name: Inland Center
summary: Bustling retail mall offering familiar stores, a kids' play area, restaurants & a casual food court.
description: Inland Center Mall serves as San Bernardino's premier enclosed shopping destination, offering a diverse mix of retail stores, dining options, and entertainment experiences. With convenient hours from 10 AM to 9 PM daily, the mall provides a comfortable climate-controlled environment for families and shoppers throughout the Inland Empire region.
demographics: Inland Center Mall primarily serves middle-income families and young adults from San Bernardino and the surrounding Inland Empire communities, with a diverse demographic mix reflecting the region's Hispanic, African American, and Caucasian populations. The trade area draws from households with median incomes ranging from $40,000 to $65,000, featuring a significant proportion of families with children seeking value-oriented shopping options. Typical visitors are value-conscious shoppers who prioritize affordability and convenience, with strong traffic during weekends and back-to-school seasons, representing a working-class to lower-middle-class market segment.
